♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: With the Moon now in sidereal Taurus, your 2nd house, after leaving fiery Aries, your focus shifts from raw initiative to practical grounding. Sun and Mercury move together in Leo through your 5th house, and Mars pushes from Gemini in your 3rd. You’re alert, opinionated and ready to act, but today’s tone is about stabilising your energy and choosing which desires are truly worth your time and resources.

💼 Career: The Leo 5th house cluster favours expressive work—presentations, design, pitching ideas, mentoring juniors, or anything that lets you demonstrate talent. Mars in the communicative 3rd adds speed to emails, calls and negotiations, but can also create impatience with slower colleagues. The Taurus Moon in your 2nd reminds you to play the long game: steadiness and quality of output will matter more than being first out of the gate. Prioritise one project where your creativity directly increases your value or visibility.

❤️ Love: Sun–Mercury in your 5th house makes your romantic life more conversational and playful. You’re inclined to tease, flirt, and talk about what excites you. The earthy Moon in Taurus, though, favours reliability over drama. In existing relationships, small demonstrations of dependability—showing up on time, following through on a promise—speak louder than big gestures. If single, you may feel drawn to someone who is both grounded and mentally stimulating; look for a person who listens as eagerly as they banter.

💰 Money: The Moon in your 2nd sign highlights cash flow, savings and self-worth. Taurus energy urges sensible choices: paying down a small debt, consolidating payments, or setting up an automatic transfer toward a future goal. With Jupiter still in Leo strengthening that 5th house, speculative ventures and risks may appear tempting, but Mars in the 3rd could make you jump too quickly on tips or gossip. Run numbers slowly, and prefer clear, tangible returns over promises of fast gains.

🧘 Advice: Before you say yes to another task or indulgence, pause and ask, “Does this feed my stability or just my restlessness?” Let that single question decide what gets your energy today.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your fire is powerful, but it’s the choices you consistently back with time and money that quietly build your real strength.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves through your own sign today, amplifying your physical awareness and emotional sensitivity. With Sun and Mercury in Leo lighting up your 4th house and Mars in Gemini activating your 2nd, you’re unusually attuned to questions of comfort, safety and material footing. You may feel both protective of what’s familiar and intrigued by subtle invitations to stretch beyond your usual pace.

💼 Career: Work themes are strongly coloured by how secure you feel in your base—your home, schedule and inner state. If those are calm, productivity can flow smoothly. Leo’s presence in your 4th can bring attention from higher-ups to how you manage your space or team culture; you might be asked to anchor a project or hold things together behind the scenes. Mars in the 2nd encourages you to speak up about compensation or resources, but avoid digging in stubbornly over minor points. A grounded, well-prepared request will travel further than emotional insistence.

❤️ Love: With the Moon in Taurus, your need for genuine physical and emotional ease in relationships is highlighted. You may crave slower time together: shared meals, a walk, or quietly sitting side by side. Sun–Mercury in your 4th favour honest conversations about family patterns, living arrangements, or what “home” with someone would actually look like. Singles could feel a pull toward someone whose presence feels soothing rather than dazzling. Trust the relationships where your body instinctively relaxes.

💰 Money: Mars in your 2nd house can bring both opportunities and urgency around finances. You may feel motivated to find new income streams or finally address a nagging expense. The Taurus Moon supports practical steps: reworking a budget, renegotiating a recurring bill, or choosing quality over quantity in purchases. Jupiter’s ongoing influence over your 4th house also favours thoughtful investment in property, education for family members, or improvements that make your environment more sustainable, not just prettier.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to move at a deliberate pace. One carefully chosen action—financial, domestic or emotional—will serve you better than rushing to fix everything at once.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you honour what genuinely feels steady and nourishing, you stop mistaking mere comfort for true security.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: With the Moon in Taurus in your 12th house, a quieter undercurrent runs beneath your usual mental buzz. Sun and Mercury in Leo energise your 3rd house, while Mars in your own sign adds extra voltage to your words and movements. Outwardly you may seem lively and talkative; inwardly, your subconscious is sorting through old impressions and half-finished stories.

💼 Career: The Leo 3rd house emphasis is excellent for writing, teaching, sales, social media, and short-term projects that require charisma and clarity. Mars travelling through Gemini increases your willingness to take initiative—setting up meetings, launching campaigns, or asserting your ideas. Yet the Taurus Moon in the 12th advises building in moments of stillness: review the implications of your decisions before sending that bold email or agreeing to a tight deadline. Behind-the-scenes research and quiet planning will raise the quality of what you put out.

❤️ Love: You’re more expressive than usual in conversations, but your deeper feelings may be slower to surface. The 12th house Moon can reawaken memories of past relationships or unspoken longings. In committed bonds, this is a good day to share one subtle truth you’ve kept in the background—about your need for space, rest, or solitude—rather than focusing only on plans and logistics. If single, you may feel a pull toward private connections: late-night messaging, distant crushes, or someone who feels familiar at a soul level. Let reality—not just imagination—guide the pace.

💰 Money: Mars in your sign often coincides with spending to match your impulses: tech, books, courses, travel, or anything that promises stimulation. Sun–Mercury in the 3rd can bring small but frequent expenses related to mobility and communication. The Taurus Moon invites you to look at what subscriptions, habits or micro-purchases quietly drain your account. Trimming just one or two of them and redirecting that amount to a specific savings goal will give you more freedom to act on the opportunities that truly matter.

🧘 Advice: Notice which ideas feel calmer and more solid after a night’s sleep. Let those, not the loudest impulses, shape your key decisions today.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your mind can spin a hundred futures; the one that lasts is the one you quietly support with consistent choices.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Taurus activates your 11th house of community and long-term aspirations, drawing your attention outward toward friends, allies and future plans. Sun and Mercury in Leo illuminate your 2nd house of values and resources, while Mars in Gemini occupies your 12th, stirring hidden tensions and private efforts. You’re reviewing who and what genuinely supports the life you’re trying to build.

💼 Career: With Leo energising your 2nd, you may be more conscious of the link between your talents and your income. This is a fertile time to consider raising your rates, asking for a review, or shaping your role to reflect what you actually do best. The Taurus Moon in the 11th favours networking that feels steady and authentic: reconnecting with an old colleague, joining a small professional group, or reaching out to someone whose work you respect. Mars in the 12th hints that some frustrations may not be fully visible yet; channel that energy into quietly upgrading your skills rather than into worry.

❤️ Love: Emotional security and shared goals take precedence over fleeting passion today. The Moon in your 11th house highlights whether your partner fits naturally into your wider social and future picture. Couples might find it helpful to talk about medium- to long-term plans—financial aims, living situations, or mutual dreams—and see where your visions sync or differ. Single Cancerians may feel an attraction emerging from friendship circles or community activities; look for signs of reliability over time, not just warmth in the moment.

💰 Money: Sun–Mercury in your 2nd house put finances and self-worth under a clear light. You might receive useful information about pay structures, side-gig possibilities, or ways to monetise an underused skill. The Taurus Moon encourages concrete, achievable goals: saving a specific amount for a project with friends, contributing more regularly to a shared resource, or creating a modest investment plan. Be mindful of Mars in the 12th: avoid secretive money moves or spending driven purely by stress or escape.

🧘 Advice: Check your plans against your energy levels. A goal is more likely to succeed if it matches the kind of life you can actually sustain, not the ideal you feel pressured to live up to.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The people and projects that truly belong in your future are the ones that help your nervous system settle, not speed up.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Sun and Mercury continue in your own sidereal Leo, alongside expansive Jupiter, making this a season of personal emphasis and visibility. Today, the Moon in Taurus climbs through your 10th house, boosting your public profile, while Mars in Gemini activates your 11th. You’re standing at a crossroads between individual expression and the larger systems and communities you move through.

💼 Career: With the Moon at the top of your chart and your Sun strong, professional matters are in sharp focus. You may receive attention from superiors, clients, or the public—even in subtle ways like increased inquiries or feedback. The Taurus Moon encourages methodical, results-oriented effort: showing consistent competence, improving the quality of your output, or taking practical steps toward a leadership role. Mars in the 11th supports bold moves within networks: proposing a collaborative project, stepping into a group organiser role, or daring to state a vision others feel but haven’t named.

❤️ Love: Your presence is hard to ignore right now, and that magnetism can bring both admiration and projection. The 10th house Moon may make your relationship status or choices more visible to others; people might have opinions. In committed bonds, you may discuss how your career path affects shared time and responsibilities. If single, attraction could arise through professional circles or public events; be clear about your intentions so that admiration doesn’t get mistaken for emotional availability you aren’t actually offering.

💰 Money: With Leo activating your 1st and Taurus your 10th, your financial picture is closely tied to your reputation and the way you show up in your work. Jupiter’s support can bring growth, but it may also tempt you to overextend with lavish spending to match a success story. Mars in the 11th favours income through networks, group efforts or technology, but can also spark conflict over shared resources in teams. Choose steady, transparent arrangements over dramatic but unclear promises.

🧘 Advice: When you feel pulled to prove yourself, ask, “What would quietly demonstrate my reliability here?” Then do that, even if nobody claps right away.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your natural shine opens doors; it’s your steady, grounded follow-through that decides which ones stay open.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Taurus lights up your 9th house of perspective, learning and distant horizons, inviting you to broaden your view. Meanwhile, your ruler Mercury travels with the Sun in Leo through your 12th house, and Mars climbs through Gemini in your 10th. It’s an interesting blend: you’re driven in public life, contemplative in private, and newly curious about how your beliefs shape your decisions.

💼 Career: Mars at the top of your chart adds ambition and sometimes pressure: deadlines, visible responsibilities, or a push to step up in leadership. Use this assertive energy to champion a project you truly believe in rather than scattering yourself across too many tasks. The Taurus Moon in your 9th favours structured learning, strategic planning and careful review of contracts, legal matters or international opportunities. Sun–Mercury in the 12th suggest that much of your best work now involves research, behind-the-scenes problem-solving, or gently unwinding inefficiencies that others overlook.

❤️ Love: With your 12th house lit, you may be more aware of subtle currents in your relationships—dreams, intuitions, moments where something feels slightly off or especially right. The 9th house Moon invites open-hearted conversations about life direction, ethics, or spiritual views. Couples can benefit from sharing not just what they’re doing but why they’re choosing it. Single Virgos might feel attracted to someone they meet through study, travel or spiritual communities, or to a person who challenges their thinking in a grounded way.

💰 Money: Mars in your 10th can increase both responsibility and reward potential. You may find that taking on a demanding assignment improves your longer-term earning power, even if the immediate payoff isn’t spectacular. The Taurus Moon supports practical moves like reviewing insurance, legal paperwork or educational investments. At the same time, the 12th house emphasis warns against financial leaks that come from inattention—auto-renewals, unused memberships, or quiet lending that never gets recorded. Bringing those into the open is an act of self-respect, not harshness.

🧘 Advice: Balance your urge to manage everything with moments of genuine rest. Insight will come more easily when you step back briefly from the details you’re trying to perfect.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your discernment is sharpest not when you tighten your grip, but when you give yourself enough space to see the whole pattern.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Taurus moves through your 8th house of shared resources and emotional depth, while Sun and Mercury in Leo activate your 11th house of friendships and long-range hopes. Mars in Gemini fires up your 9th, sparking restlessness for exploration or learning. You’re being nudged to look honestly at the bonds and agreements that underpin your big-picture dreams.

💼 Career: The Leo 11th house focus is favourable for group projects, professional communities, and initiatives that connect you to a wider audience or network. You may be asked to mediate, host, or harmonise different viewpoints. The Taurus Moon in the 8th brings attention to funding, budgets, and hidden terms—who pays for what, where responsibilities are uneven, or how shared time and effort are valued. Mars in the 9th can push you toward courses, certifications, or travel that broaden your career path. Choose options that strengthen your actual expertise rather than just your image.

❤️ Love: With the Moon in your 8th house, emotional honesty and trust are highlighted. You might sense unspoken fears—about commitment, vulnerability, or past hurts—surfacing for review. In existing relationships, this is a supportive day for calmly clarifying boundaries around privacy, money, or emotional labour. If single, you could feel drawn to someone intense or intriguing, perhaps from a different culture or belief system (Mars in the 9th). Take time to see whether your values and life pace are compatible beneath the initial fascination.

💰 Money: Eighth-house activation often coincides with attention to taxes, inheritances, loans, or partner’s income. The Taurus Moon encourages steady, realistic conversations: organising documents, reviewing repayment plans, or agreeing on fair divisions of shared costs. Sun–Mercury in the 11th may bring financial opportunities through friends or community—joint ventures, crowdfunding, or collaborative offers. Weigh them carefully: ensure that expectations are written down and that your role matches your reward.

🧘 Advice: If a topic makes you slightly uncomfortable but clearly matters—especially about money or trust—take one small step toward naming it today.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Harmony isn’t the absence of tension; it’s the result of facing what’s hidden and arranging it with care.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Taurus illuminates your 7th house of one-to-one partnerships, bringing relationships to the foreground. At the same time, Sun and Mercury in Leo occupy your 10th house of career and reputation, while Mars in Gemini moves through your 8th. You’re aware of how much your public role, intimate bonds and shared obligations intertwine.

💼 Career: Leo at the top of your chart spotlights leadership, performance and accountability. You may be more visible in your organisation or industry, whether through responsibility or recognition. The Taurus Moon in your 7th suggests that co-operation is essential: clients, collaborators or colleagues play a decisive role in moving things forward. Mars in the 8th hints at negotiations around funding, fees, or resource distribution; power dynamics may feel more charged. Approach talks with calm firmness and a clear sense of your minimum acceptable terms.

❤️ Love: The 7th house Moon tends to make relationship needs more obvious. Partners may seek reassurance, clear plans or evidence of commitment. Your own desire for loyalty and stability is strong, but Mars in the 8th can stir old fears around control, jealousy, or loss. Use today to have grounded conversations about practical aspects of partnership—shared schedules, responsibilities, or financial matters—rather than testing each other’s devotion indirectly. Single Scorpios might meet someone through work or formal settings whose steady energy attracts them; let trust build gradually through consistent actions.

💰 Money: With Mars in your 8th, joint finances, debts, taxes and long-term obligations are active themes. There may be an impulse to resolve everything immediately—refinance, close accounts, or push for quick answers. The Taurus Moon encourages a more measured approach: list out what’s owed or shared, seek advice if needed, and prioritise what affects stability most. Sun–Mercury in the 10th can bring conversations about bonuses, profit-sharing or responsibility-linked pay; negotiate from a place of clear self-respect rather than from anxiety.

🧘 Advice: When intensity rises, ground yourself in facts: numbers, dates, specific agreements. Let clarity calm the stories your mind wants to spin.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your depth is a gift, but it serves you best when it turns from guessing motives to understanding practical realities.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Taurus travels through your 6th house of routines, health rhythms and service, nudging you toward practical order. Sun and Mercury in fellow fire sign Leo highlight your 9th house—your natural arena of vision, travel and learning—while Mars in Gemini activates your 7th. You’re balancing daily responsibilities with a strong urge to expand your horizons and engage more fully with others.

💼 Career: The 9th house Leo energy supports activities like teaching, consulting, publishing, legal matters and international connections. You may receive or generate ideas that stretch beyond everyday tasks. Yet the Moon in the 6th reminds you that big visions need reliable systems: schedules, clear workflows, and realistic time estimates. Mars in the 7th can bring dynamic but sometimes confrontational interactions with partners, clients or competitors. Use that spark to clarify agreements and energise collaborations rather than to win every debate.

❤️ Love: With Mars energising your 7th house, relationships carry more charge—this can manifest as passion, lively exchanges, or occasional friction. The key is how you handle differences. The Taurus Moon suggests that showing up consistently—keeping promises, being present when you said you would—will mean more than grand romantic statements. Singles may feel drawn to someone assertive or outspoken, possibly met through work, study or travel-related settings. Notice whether your paths in life realistically intersect, not just whether the chemistry is strong.

💰 Money: The 6th house Moon turns attention to income from regular work, bills, and the cost of maintaining your lifestyle. Small improvements—streamlining a recurring expense, renegotiating a service, or setting up a more efficient routine—can create financial breathing room. Sun–Mercury in the 9th may inspire spending on courses, trips or legal matters; choose those that clearly support your longer-term growth. With Mars in the 7th, be precise about money in partnerships: who pays what, when, and how adjustments will be handled if circumstances change.

🧘 Advice: Align one piece of your daily rhythm with your bigger ideals today—a short practice, a study slot, or a modest saving habit that reflects where you want to go.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your future isn’t built in flashes of inspiration alone; it grows out of the small, repeatable choices you make with others each day.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Taurus moves through your 5th house of creativity, play and self-expression, softening your usual seriousness. Sun and Mercury in Leo highlight your 8th house of shared resources and inner transformation, while Saturn, your ruler, continues its disciplined course, and Mars in Gemini occupies your 6th. You’re invited to take your pleasures and talents seriously without turning them into yet another heavy duty.

💼 Career: Mars in the 6th boosts your capacity for effort and problem-solving, though it can also heighten irritability with inefficiency or disorganisation. Channel that drive into refining systems rather than into criticism. The Taurus Moon in your 5th house encourages you to bring more heart and originality into your work: proposing a creative angle, improving the aesthetic of something, or mentoring in a way that feels genuinely encouraging. Sun–Mercury in the 8th may bring discussions around budgets, confidential projects or restructuring; your steady approach is needed to navigate complexities.

❤️ Love: With the 5th house activated by the Moon, romance and joy become more accessible—if you allow them. You may feel a desire to relax your guard and let someone see a more playful side. At the same time, the 8th house emphasis suggests deeper conversations about trust, intimacy or shared emotional baggage. In established relationships, mixing light-hearted activities with a willingness to touch on serious topics can be powerful. Single Capricorns might connect with someone through hobbies, children, or artistic environments; notice who encourages you to soften without losing your self-respect.

💰 Money: Eighth-house transits often coincide with changes or reflections around shared finances, loans, inheritances, or insurance. Sun–Mercury there can highlight where information has been missing or where you need clearer terms. The Taurus Moon supports steady, grounded choices: channelling a portion of any extra income into savings, or investing carefully in something that brings both satisfaction and potential return. Mars in the 6th suggests that improving your skills and work habits now can gradually strengthen your earning power.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to enjoy one simple, non-productive pleasure today without justifying it. Let your nervous system feel what “effort plus ease” actually tastes like.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your strength isn’t only in how much you can carry; it’s in learning which joys are worth making room for on purpose.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Taurus activates your 4th house of home, roots and emotional foundations, turning your attention inward even as the world calls. Sun and Mercury in Leo illuminate your 7th house of partnerships, and Mars in Gemini energises your 5th. You’re navigating between private needs, relationship dynamics and a renewed urge to express yourself more boldly.

💼 Career: Although today’s mood leans domestic or inward, the Leo 7th house emphasis keeps collaboration central. Agreements with clients, colleagues or business partners may require attention, especially around fairness and visibility. Mars in the 5th can add confidence to your creative output or public contributions: you may feel ready to present, perform or pitch something that carries your unique stamp. The Taurus Moon advises building your professional moves on emotional steadiness—tidying your workspace, resolving a home distraction, or honouring a need for quiet before important conversations.

❤️ Love: With your 7th house bright, relationship themes are lively. You may see more clearly how your partner supports or challenges your sense of self, or what you seek in a close bond if you’re single. The 4th house Moon raises questions about emotional safety: can you relax and be unguarded with this person? Mars in the 5th heightens passion, flirtation and playful risk-taking. Enjoy the spark, but listen closely to what your deeper self needs in order to feel at home in a connection.

💰 Money: Financial decisions are coloured by both relational and emotional factors right now. Sun–Mercury in the 7th highlight negotiations, contracts and shared ventures; you may discuss fees, revenue splits or mutual investments. The Taurus Moon suggests favouring choices that stabilise your base—rent or mortgage, essential home items, or a small buffer fund—over flashy expenses. Mars in the 5th can encourage spending on entertainment, children or hobbies; a modest budget for joy can be healthy, so long as it doesn’t erode your core security.

🧘 Advice: Before agreeing to anything important with another person, check in with your body. If your chest tightens or your jaw clenches, that’s data—slow down and ask more questions.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The partnerships that truly belong in your life are the ones where your inner world can exhale, not just your mind be impressed.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Taurus moves through your 3rd house of communication, learning and local environment, encouraging practical conversations and short, focused tasks. Sun and Mercury in Leo highlight your 6th house of work and health patterns, while Mars in Gemini stimulates your 4th. You’re being called to tidy the small moving parts of daily life so that your sensitive nature feels less overwhelmed.

💼 Career: The 6th house Leo emphasis can bring attention to your role in the workplace—how you organise tasks, support others and handle responsibility. You may be noticed for your diligence or for bringing warmth to routine matters. The Taurus Moon in the 3rd supports productive calls, emails, writing and planning; it’s an excellent day to clarify instructions, break big tasks into manageable steps, or update schedules. Mars in the 4th can stir restlessness at home or tension with family members; if possible, separate domestic concerns from professional interactions so they don’t blur into each other.

❤️ Love: Communication is the heart of relationship energy today. You might find that simple, grounded exchanges—talking about your day, planning meals, discussing logistics—carry unexpected emotional weight. With Mars active in your 4th, deeper feelings about safety, belonging or old family patterns may surface quickly. In committed partnerships, gently naming how home dynamics affect your mood can open useful dialogue. Single Pisceans could feel interest spark close to home—neighbours, local gatherings, or familiar online spaces—where small talk can evolve into something more meaningful over time.

💰 Money: The 3rd house Moon highlights everyday expenses: transport, communication, small purchases. A few intentional adjustments here can noticeably improve your finances. Sun–Mercury in the 6th may bring information about work-related income, overtime, or side tasks; be clear about boundaries so that extra effort is properly compensated. Mars in the 4th can trigger spending on home improvements or family needs; prioritise what genuinely improves functionality or wellbeing rather than what only soothes short-term discomfort.

🧘 Advice: Choose one corner of your life—desk, inbox, calendar, or a room at home—and bring it into a little more order today. The emotional relief will be larger than the effort.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your sensitivity thrives when the basics are cared for; clearing small tangles in your day makes space for your intuition to speak clearly.
